mainEntity.name: Are AI real estate search tools free to use, or do they involve a cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI real estate search tools varies; many basic tools offered directly to consumers are free, while more advanced platforms or features may come with subscription fees or be integrated into agent services. When working with a real estate professional like Kelby Contreras, access to sophisticated AI-powered search capabilities might be part of the service provided, often without direct additional cost to the client. This typically means you benefit from advanced insights without paying extra for the technology itself.
